literal: Battle-in brave-men like, one's-own-people-among-even those-who-bear upon-indeed burden.
translation: Just as the brunt of a battle falls on the brave, the burden of uplifting a family rests only on those capable of bearing it among their people.
modern: போர்க்களத்தில் எப்படி வீரர்கள்தான் முன்நின்று போரைத் தாங்குவார்களோ, அதுபோல ஒரு குடியில் உள்ளவர்களிலும் திறமையுள்ளவர்கள்தான் அக்குடியை உயர்த்தும் பொறுப்பைத் தாங்குவார்கள்.
explanation: The couplet compares the responsibility of uplifting a family to fighting in a battle. In a battlefield, it is the brave warriors who step forward and bear the brunt of the fight. Similarly, even among one's own relatives, the heavy burden of supporting and elevating the family naturally falls upon those who have the capacity and willingness to bear it. The word 'பொறை' (burden) signifies the difficult task of maintaining the family's honor and prosperity.
